findings.claim: Visa 10-K FY2025 指出新科技與創新正催生許多偏離傳統網路支付模式的新進入者（GenAI 代理商務、區塊鏈、穩定幣等），且部分國家監管環境正在催生本地網路或額外的處理端競爭。
findings.excerpt: These advances are enabling new entrants, many of which depart from traditional network payment models. In certain countries, the evolving regulatory landscape is creating local networks or enabling additional processing competition.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出即時支付（RTP）網路已在至少 80 國上線，由政府推動（FedNow、PIX、UPI），成為卡組織的替代方案，跨境 RTP 連結亦將與 Visa 跨境業務競爭。
findings.excerpt: RTP networks have launched in at least 80 countries and continue to be driven by strong government sponsorship and regulatory initiatives to enable and drive adoption (e.g., FedNow in the U.S., PIX in Brazil and United Payments Interface (UPI) in India), increasing their position as an alternative to payment card schemes.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未取得 2026 年 Visa 對 Mastercard 等對手的量化份額消長資料；第二次搜尋命中皆為移民簽證，無關。

clues.claim: Visa 高層表示穩定幣需求在美歐偏弱，但在跨境、匯款與 B2B 強勁。
